### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s).

**17** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 394f65e891f0ac6c6be708fb807740d5cb446520`.

⛔ **8** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **28** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 394f65e891f0ac6c6be708fb807740d5cb446520` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `4cfcd1989889a1017a68e7f30afedb7b56abed8d` — the merge of head `fb8ae99116f3dd4be636386877b5464096a1d44d` into base `394f65e891f0ac6c6be708fb807740d5cb446520`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 4cfcd1989889a1017a68e7f30afedb7b56abed8d && git checkout 4cfcd1989889a1017a68e7f30afedb7b56abed8d
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 394f65e891f0ac6c6be708fb807740d5cb446520 fb8ae99116f3dd4be636386877b5464096a1d44d && git checkout -B drift-repro 394f65e891f0ac6c6be708fb807740d5cb446520 && git merge --no-ff fb8ae99116f3dd4be636386877b5464096a1d44d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 394f65e891f0ac6c6be708fb807740d5cb446520
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 394f65e891f0ac6c6be708fb807740d5cb446520` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

✅ ACCEPT: PR #23500 at `fb8ae99116` (#23391). It lands on an all-green head; no contract review is owed · 2026-10-14T14:18Z

`domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01Q9PZ5Pzqcus4woVvTZwWNU` · holder of claim `6168051933`. Report `6170469233`. Thread-read: `6170469233`.

**Checklist, read against GitHub and `origin/main`, not against the report:**
- **PR shape:** draft, base `main`, title `fix(cli):`, assignee `sunhaolin`. Line 1 is `Fixes #23391`, the body's only closing keyword; line 2 is `Clause-②: no`.
- **Scope:** 3 files, +201 / −2, inside the claim's surface: the `report.failed > 0` branch of `commands/migrate/meta.ts`, one new pin file in `packages/cli/test/`, and one changeset. `check-governed-merges --pr 23500`: NOT governed. No `content/docs/releases/` change. `--json` is untouched.
- **The text, checked against the diff and the measurements.** The new line holds in every mix of failed kinds.
  - **Shared sentence:** "Each stays as stored, and reads as it did before this run, until the reason printed beside it is fixed." The pass writes no `failed` row. The reason is printed on the row's own line by `formatStoredMigrationReport`, which is why "beside it" replaces the old "above".
  - **Invalid-JSON sentence:** "a row whose stored body is not valid JSON does not load at all." It is printed always, worded as a conditional, and measured: `getMetaItem` answers `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, and the flow is not registered.
  - **Flow sentence:** "a flow whose reason says it does not canonicalize is refused by the engine at boot as well, so it is not registered and does not run." It is gated structurally on a failed row's `type === 'flow'`, never on reason prose; the report carries no kind field.
    - Measured: `getFlow` answers `null` and the registration reads `refused` with the parse error.
    - Cited: `flow-cold-boot-refusal-withdraw.test.ts` and `flow-refused-registration-read.integration.test.ts`, plus `registerFlow` calling the same `canonicalizeFlow` the stored pass throws from.
    - The dev dropped a claim about how such a flow reads, because the invalid-JSON mix makes it read `unregistered`. No Studio claim and no "will run once" claim.
  - **"Nothing is broken" goes for every kind.** The card allows keeping it only where measured true. The conversion-refused flow is registered, and the refused re-save reads as before; the shared sentence states that without the stronger "nothing is broken". Narrower than allowed, and true.
- **Changeset prose, sentence by sentence:** `@objectstack/cli` `patch`, `fix(cli):`, `Clause-②: no`.
  - "false for two of the pass's four failed kinds" matches the measurements.
  - The FROM and TO strings are the exact old and new lines.
  - "the exit code (1)" holds: a run that is not clean sets `exitCode = 1` before this branch, unchanged.
  - "The flow sentence is printed only when a failed row is a flow" matches the gate.
- **Pins and reverse verification:**
  - `migrate-meta-stored-failed.test.ts`, 3 cases through the command's human output: a failed flow row, a non-flow control, and a mixed `--apply` run.
  - Two ablations, each landing and restore proven against HEAD:
    - putting the retired sentence back turns all 3 red;
    - forcing the flow gate false turns the flow and mixed pins red, while the control stays green.
- **Gates:**
  - **Local, at `fb8ae99116`:** the dev ran the 65 derived gates. Two first exited 3 on unbuilt dists, and both exited 0 after the build: 65 run, 0 unmeasured. Whole-repo `pnpm lint` exited 0. The CLI typecheck exited 0. The CLI unit tier passed once the CLI was built (two published-subpath pins need a build).
  - **Gate evidence: the check-runs pinned to `fb8ae99116`, read at this stamp.** There are 37 runs: 18 `success`, 6 skipped, 13 still running, and none failed.
    - Every skip is on the expected-skip roster: `Dogfood Regression Gate (${{ matrix.shard }}/3)`, Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Dogfood Verify CLI, Temporal Conformance, and Packed-tarball smoke.
    - Landing reads them again.
- **Contract review:** none owed. The diff touches none of the three faces: operator text in `packages/cli`, `Clause-②: no`, no schema, no governed path. CI plus this seat's read (`contract-review.md`).
- **Docs drift:** none owed.

**Accepted deviations:**
- **A correction of this seat's dispatch, in public.** Hypothesis (a) listed the `failed` producers wrongly, and the dev measured the true list:
  - An organization-scoped row is `skipped`, never `failed`.
  - The first producer is the invalid-JSON body.
  - The fourth kind the order did not name is "conversion refused" over a live name (flow only).
  - On `main` `0d3ea295d1` the four sit at about `:23352`, `:23405`, `:23417` and `:23550`.
  - The order's suspicion that the invalid-JSON kind is false too was confirmed.
- **A throwaway measurement harness** sat outside the surface (`service-automation/src/zz-measure-23391.integration.test.ts`). It ran twice and was moved out before the first commit, so it was never committed. The tree is clean.
- **Whole-repo `pnpm lint` was run.** That satisfies both the lane's line and the role file.

**Out-of-scope findings, one line each:**
- One `sys_metadata` row whose body is not valid JSON makes its whole type's list read answer `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`. With a flow row, the `kernel:ready` bind then does nothing, so a flow it would refuse stays registered. **Acceptance notes**, 「承接者:无」. It was measured at the producers `protocol.getMetaItems` and `getMetaItemsForExecution` on a real kernel, not at a public door, and no real producer of such a body is named. So it has no `reach:` (`filing-gate.md:15`, `:21`). This seat is surfacing it to the maintainer in its session chat.
- `StoredMigrationRow` names no failed kind, so a consumer cannot tell kinds apart without matching reason prose. **Acceptance notes**, 「承接者:无」 (an observation, not one of the three classes).

**Landing:** `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the relay once every check on the current head is `success` or a roster skip.
